even.en: Two rivers of equal depth meet; neither swallows the other.
even.zh: 两水同深相汇，无一能吞其伴。

even.en: When the scales rest level, the merchant should sleep soundly.
A fair exchange leaves both gardens green.
The wise trader gains a friend when he gains nothing else.
even.zh: 智者交易，纵无所获，亦得一友。

even.en: Equal weights on the yoke make the ox walk straight.
even.zh: 轭上两担相等，牛行自直。

even.en: A balanced trade is a bridge; both banks may cross.
even.zh: 均衡之交易如桥，两岸皆可渡。

even.en: Neither the mountain nor the sea has been cheated today.
When two stones weigh the same, choose the one that fits your wall.
Fair winds fill both sails alike.
Where nothing is stolen, nothing need be defended.
A tie in trade is a victory over greed.
The moon shows the same face to both fishermen.
Trade even, sleep even.
Two cups filled from one pot hold the same tea.
even.zh: 一壶所斟两杯，茶味无二。

even.en: An honest exchange needs no witness.
Balanced weights do not tip the cart; look instead to the road ahead.
When value meets value, only need decides.
The reed and the willow bend the same in this wind.
A fair trade is water: it takes the shape of whoever holds it.
even.zh: 公平之易如水，随器而形。

even.en: Even scales are the quiet beginning of a long friendship.
Two equal stones make a steady path.
The trade is fair; now ask which player fits your season.
even.zh: 交易既公，且问何人合汝之季。

even.en: In a level exchange, the winner is the one who planned for the bye.
even.zh: 交易齐平，胜者乃预谋轮空之人。

even.en: Neither side leaves the market richer, but neither leaves poorer.

slight.en: A feather tips the scale, yet the scale still tips.
The stream favors one bank by a pebble's width.
slight.zh: 溪流偏爱一岸，仅一石之宽。

slight.en: Small edges sharpen into blades over a long season.
slight.zh: 细微之优势，长季磨成利刃。

slight.en: One extra grain each day fills the granary by winter.
The taller bamboo catches the first rain.
A slight lean is enough to spill the cup.
Do not scorn a small gain; the ant builds mountains grain by grain.
The wind favors one kite, though both still fly.
A little more water, a little taller rice.
The river bends slightly, but it bends toward one village.
A whisker of value is still value.
One side smiles a little wider tonight.
slight.zh: 今夜一方之笑，略宽一线。

slight.en: The advantage is thin as rice paper, and rice paper still covers the window.
slight.zh: 优势薄如宣纸，宣纸亦能蔽窗。

slight.en: The gardener who plants one more seed reaps one more melon.
A gentle slope still carries the water downhill.
The heavier coin is not much heavier, but it is heavier.
Small gains, quietly kept, become loud in December.
One stone more in the wall keeps out one more wind.
The slight edge belongs to the one who counted the bye weeks.
slight.zh: 细微之优，归于数过轮空之人。

slight.en: A half-step ahead is still ahead.
The scale trembles, then settles: one side is favored.
Even a small surplus is a seed for the next trade.
slight.zh: 小小盈余，亦是下次交易之种。

slight.en: The candle burns a little longer for one household.
Do not celebrate loudly; a slight lead is a lantern, not a sun.
slight.zh: 勿高声庆，微优是灯，非日。

clear.en: The eagle does not trade its wings for a heavier nest.
One side carries gold home; the other carries the sack.
clear.zh: 一方携金归，一方携空袋。

clear.en: The clear stream reveals which stone is jade.
clear.zh: 清溪之下，何石为玉，一目了然。

clear.en: When the tide goes out, we see who was swimming with a rock.
A wise general trades a hundred spears for one true sword.
The harvest clearly favors the field that was watered.
One merchant sold silk and one sold shadows.
The mountain does not argue with the hill about height.
The stronger ox pulls the cart; the trade has chosen its ox.
clear.zh: 壮牛拉车，交易已择其牛。

clear.en: Quality is a lantern; quantity is a pile of unlit wicks.
clear.zh: 质如明灯，量如未燃之烬。

clear.en: A single pearl outweighs a handful of sand.
The river of value flows plainly toward one shore.
One side planted an orchard; the other planted weeds.
clear.zh: 一方植果园，一方种野草。

clear.en: The winner of this trade need not raise his voice.
Gold is heavier than its shine suggests, and so is this win.
The archer who aimed at the moon has struck the moon.
The tide of value has clearly turned toward one harbor.
Give away the ox and keep the rope, and you will pull nothing.
One fisherman traded his net for a song; the other still eats.
clear.zh: 一渔以网换歌，一渔仍有食。

clear.en: The bell has rung, and it rings for one side.
Value favors the patient; today it favors one side plainly.
clear.zh: 价值偏爱耐心者，今日明偏一方。

clear.en: Do not count the players; weigh them. The scale has spoken.
clear.zh: 勿数其人，当衡其重，秤已言。

clear.en: The wiser hand has closed around the brighter stone.
A clear victory in the market is a quiet victory in December.

lopsided.en: He who trades the dragon for a lizard should not wonder why the sky is empty.
lopsided.zh: 以龙换蜥者，勿怪天空空荡。

lopsided.en: The fox has left the henhouse; count your chickens.
One side sold the moon for a lantern.
A palace was traded for a tent, and the tent leaks.
The commissioner's brush should pause over this scroll.
lopsided.zh: 盟主之笔，当于此卷前停驻。

lopsided.en: The wolf offers a fair price only to the sheep.
A robbery in daylight is still a robbery.
One side took the harvest and left the scarecrow.
The river has been sold, and the buyer received a bucket.
When the trade is this crooked, even the wind whistles a warning.
lopsided.zh: 交易如此歪斜，风亦鸣警。

lopsided.en: The gold left the room; the shine stayed behind.
Ask not who won. Ask who was asleep.
One merchant fleeced the other so cleanly the sheep felt no cold.
lopsided.zh: 一商剃另一商之毛，净至羊不觉寒。

lopsided.en: A hundred pebbles do not buy one mountain.
The tiger has traded its stripes for a promise.
Veto is a word, and this trade whispers it.
lopsided.zh: 否决乃一词，此交易低语之。

lopsided.en: The lantern was traded for the darkness it once lit.
The strong side left with a smile the weak side paid for.
lopsided.zh: 强者带笑而去，笑价由弱者付。

lopsided.en: When one side kneels to hand over the jade, the elders should speak.
lopsided.zh: 一方跪献美玉，长者当言。

lopsided.en: This is not a trade; it is a gift with a signature.
lopsided.zh: 此非交易，乃署名之赠礼。

lopsided.en: The tide did not turn; it simply left one boat on the sand.
lopsided.zh: 潮未转向，惟弃一舟于沙。

lopsided.en: Heaven notes the fleecing, and so does the league chat.
lopsided.zh: 苍天记剃毛之事，联盟群聊亦然。

lopsided.en: A crooked scale still weighs, and it has weighed heavily against one side.
Trade the sun for a candle and you will learn what night means.
lopsided.zh: 以日换烛，方知夜为何物。

general.en: The river does not hurry, yet it arrives.
general.zh: 河不疾行，然必至。

general.en: Patience is the sharpest blade in the manager's drawer.
general.zh: 耐心乃经理抽屉中最利之刃。

general.en: The bye week teaches humility to the loudest captain.
general.zh: 轮空周教最喧之将谦卑。

general.en: A silent river hides the deepest stones.
general.zh: 静水之下，藏最深之石。

general.en: Do not chase last week's points; they have already flown south.
general.zh: 勿追上周之分，其已南飞。

general.en: The wise farmer plants before the rain, not after.
general.zh: 智农雨前播种，非雨后。

general.en: A roster is a garden; prune before the frost.
general.zh: 阵容如园，霜前修剪。

general.en: Injury is the storm no forecast fully sees.
general.zh: 伤病乃预报难尽之风暴。

general.en: The waiver wire is a river; the patient fisherman eats.
general.zh: 弃补名单如河，耐心渔者有食。

general.en: Value is not the number; it is the number minus what you could have had for free.
general.zh: 价值非数字，乃数字减去本可免费所得。

general.en: Count the starters, not the bench; the bench does not score.
general.zh: 数首发，勿数替补，替补不得分。

general.en: The one who plans for December wins in December.
general.zh: 为腊月谋者，腊月胜。

general.en: A trade is a mirror; it shows what you truly value.
general.zh: 交易如镜，映汝真正所重。

general.en: Rumor is a loud drum; projection is a quiet flute. Follow the flute.
general.zh: 流言如鼓喧，预测如笛静，随笛而行。

general.en: The mountain was not moved by a single trade, nor was the season.
general.zh: 一易不移山，一易不定季。

general.en: Every roster has a weak beam; find yours before the wind does.
general.zh: 每阵皆有弱梁，先风寻之。

general.en: The tortoise sets its lineup on Thursday; the hare forgets on Sunday.
general.zh: 龟周四排阵，兔周日忘之。

general.en: Depth is the umbrella you buy before the rain.
general.zh: 深度乃雨前所购之伞。

general.en: The scoreboard remembers nothing; the standings remember everything.
general.zh: 记分板无记忆，排名录尽记。

general.en: A single star lights a sky, but a lineup needs nine.
general.zh: 一星照天，然阵容需九星。

general.en: To read the schedule is to read the future in pencil.
general.zh: 读赛程者，以铅笔读未来。

general.en: The market rewards the calm hand and punishes the trembling one.
general.zh: 市场赏静手，罚颤手。

general.en: Bury no player before his bye week; many return.
general.zh: 轮空前勿葬其人，多有归来者。

general.en: The prophecy is only as good as the projections beneath it.
general.zh: 预言之善，仅如其下之预测。
